answers.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(fee_sats) AS REAL) / 100000000.0 AS value FROM transactions WHERE height = 840000 AND is_coinbase = 0

SELECT CAST((SELECT SUM(o.value_sats) FROM outputs o WHERE o.height = 840000 AND o.txid = (SELECT txid FROM transactions WHERE height = 840000 AND is_coinbase = 1)) - b.subsidy_sats AS REAL) / 100000000.0 AS value FROM blocks b WHERE b.height = 840000
